components.css: .ds-final-tile { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr; gap: 48px; padding: 64px 48px; border-radius: 0; background: var(--accent, #FF3300); color: var(--background, #090909); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-final-tile h2 { max-width: 12ch; margin: 0; font: 600 clamp(51px, 8.6vw, 128px)/0.96 var(--font-display, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-final-tile p { max-width: 42rem; margin: 32px 0 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-final-form { align-self: end; } .ds-final-form input, .ds-final-form button { width: 100%; min-height: 56px; border-radius: 0; font-size: 16px; } .ds-final-form input { padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(9, 9, 9, 0.7); background: transparent; color: var(--background, #090909); } .ds-final-form button { margin-top: 20px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; background: var(--background, #090909); color: var(--foreground, #EDEDED); font-family: var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); font-size: 14px; } .ds-final-form input:focus-visible, .ds-final-form button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--background, #090909); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Illustrative Reconstruction Stage

components.css: .ds-reconstruction { position: relative; min-height: 520px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-work, #151515); color: var(--foreground, #EDEDED); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-reconstruction-old, .ds-reconstruction-new { position: absolute; inset: 0; } .ds-reconstruction-old { background: var(--background, #090909); } .ds-reconstruction-old::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 7%; top: 12%; width: 62%; height: 18%; border: 1px solid rgba(237, 237, 237, 0.15); background: rgba(237, 237, 237, 0.025); } .ds-reconstruction-old span, .ds-reconstruction-new span { position: absolute; left: 24px; bottom: 24px; font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-reconstruction-new { background: var(--foreground, #EDEDED); color: var(--background, #090909); clip-path: circle(150px at 68% 52%); transition: clip-path 1200ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-reconstruction:hover .ds-reconstruction-new { clip-path: circle(42% at 68% 52%); } .ds-reconstruction-new small { position: absolute; left: 6%; top: 8%; right: 6%; padding-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(9, 9, 9, 0.2); font: 400 10px/1.4 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-reconstruction-new strong { position: absolute; left: 6%; top: 20%; font: 600 clamp(54px, 9vw, 144px)/0.79 var(--font-display, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-reconstruction-new i { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 50%; height: 42%; background: var(--accent, #FF3300); } .ds-reconstruction figcaption { position: absolute; z-index: 2; right: 20px; top: 20px; color: #fff; mix-blend-mode: difference; font: 400 10px/1.4 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
Nét Nút treats an inherited website as material on a worktable: inspect what exists, identify the friction, reflow the meaning, and rebuild a clearer system. The visual language is direct and specialist rather than polished agency theater. Oversized variable display type, ruled fields, hard-edged blocks, and a single vermilion intervention make the act of thinking visible without pretending to perform an audit.

The system is Vietnamese-first, high-contrast, and materially flat. Its energy comes from compression and release: dense rows and labels give way to large declarations, asymmetric twelve-column compositions, and a focused conversion plane. Motion reveals hierarchy, comparison, transformation, or state; semantic HTML, native controls, visible labels, and static content remain complete without it.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black worktable with off-white paper and one vermilion signal.
Squared navigation rails and conversion actions; pills are state-only.
Roboto Flex display states paired with Geist Sans and Geist Mono.
Asymmetric editorial compositions rather than equal feature-card grids.
Hairlines, flat blocks, clipping, and tonal opacity instead of ornamental depth.
Vietnamese-first copy with direct, specialist language.
Illustrative reconstruction visuals explicitly labeled as concepts.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is the only chromatic voice; use it for intervention, state, and conversion, never as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Worktable Rule
rules.body: Black and paper carry the reading experience. Neutral opacity may create hierarchy, but it must not become a second palette.

rules.name: The Crop Before Ornament Rule
rules.body: Create energy with scale, line breaks, width-axis changes, and edge proximity before adding a decorative object.

rules.name: The Axis Is Meaning Rule
rules.body: Use Roboto Flex width and grade changes to distinguish readable, compressed, expanded, and released statements; never use variation to hide text or reduce legibility.

rules.name: The Refused Balance Rule
rules.body: Do not center the hero or distribute equal cards; preserve visible tension through offset starts, uneven spans, and intentional empty space.

rules.name: The Mobile Truth Rule
rules.body: Mobile is a complete reading and action path, not a compressed desktop composition.

rules.name: The Flat Reconstruction Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay shadowless; communicate hierarchy with scale, hairlines, overlap, clipping, and tonal contrast.

rules.name: The Geometry Split Rule
rules.body: Use hard rectangles for content, navigation rails, CTA actions, fields, and conversion planes; use pills only for compact state tags and phase toggles.

rules.name: The Feedback Must Explain Rule
rules.body: Every animation must reveal hierarchy, comparison, progress, or control state; decorative motion alone does not belong.

dos: Do let one oversized statement establish each major section before supporting copy.
Do use vermilion as a structural cut, active state, or conversion surface—not as ambient decoration.
Do use Roboto Flex width and grade states to make editorial density readable.
Do keep synthetic reconstruction visuals labeled `Concept minh họa` until approved project media exists.
Do preserve visible focus, semantic labels, touch targets, truthful local confirmations, and reduced-motion fallbacks.
Do collapse desktop asymmetry into a direct single-column mobile order below 768px.
donts: Don't balance the hero into a centered agency template or repeat equal feature-card grids.
Don't introduce extra hues, purple or mesh gradients, ornamental shadows, neon effects, 3D objects, or glossy translucent cards.
Don't invent client logos, testimonials, metrics, project photography, business outcomes, or URL-specific diagnoses.
Don't add motion that hides essential content, depends on raw scroll listeners, or requires a custom cursor.
Don't use decorative numbering, decorative dashes, scroll-cue filler, marquee filler, or fake terminal output.
